Bengaluru Tech Summit Focuses on AI and Global Collaboration

The 29th Bengaluru Tech Summit has commenced, focusing on the theme 'AI & Beyond'. The event brings together global technology leaders, startups, and policymakers. Concurrently, Bennett University's Global AI Summit has also begun, addressing the rising challenges and threats posed by artificial intelligence.
